address: The Floral Hall, Stoney Street, Borough Market, London,SE1 1TL
bio: Situated above London's oldest market place, Roast at Borough Market uses quintessentially British ingredients to create a classic Afternoon Tea that both supports and celebrates Britain’s farmers and producers.  Wherever you sit, there is a view - either into the open kitchen, over Borough Market or across the Thames to St. Paul’s Cathedral.  The 'A Taste of Roast' Afternoon Tea menu features classic finger sandwiches, including roast pork with piccalilli sauce and sage scotch egg, and braised beef croquettes. The selection of desserts includes fresh fruit tart, vanilla cheesecake and choux buns. It is served alongside a wide selection of teas and infusions, including Roast Special Blend, Earl Grey and Japanese Sencha.  Afternoon Tea is available Monday - Saturday from 11:45am to 5:30pm. Please note that Afternoon Tea will NOT be served throughout December.  Please inform us of all dietary requirements a minimum of 48 hours in advance. Should you require any substitutions or modifications to the items outside our available menus, a £5 per Afternoon Tea charge will be added to your bill.
